---
name: "nf-core/orftable_fasta_gtf_buildorfcatalogue"
description: "Build a multi-caller Ribo-seq ORF catalogue from per-sample, per-caller\n\
  ORF prediction tables. Chains:\n\n  1. `custom/orfnormalise` (one invocation per\
  \ caller-tagged input;\n     dispatch by the per-record `caller` val) - reconciles\
  \ each\n     caller's native output table into a unified BED12 + sidecar TSV.\n\
  \  2. `custom/orfmerge` (one cohort-level invocation) - class-aware\n     clustering\
  \ of normalised calls across callers and samples.\n  3. `bedtools/getfasta` + `seqkit/translate`\
  \ - lifts the merged BED12\n     into a catalogue AA FASTA.\n  4. `mmseqs/easycluster`\
  \ + `custom/orfcollapse` (optional, `val_collapse`) -\n     clusters catalogue peptides\
  \ by amino-acid identity and folds duplicate\n     small ORFs to one representative\
  \ each.\n\nThe collapse identity threshold defaults to `--min-seq-id 0.9` (the GENCODE\n\
  Ribo-seq ORF catalogue convention; Mudge et al. 2022), set on\n`MMSEQS_EASYCLUSTER`\
  \ in this subworkflow's `nextflow.config`. Override it via\n`ext.args` on `MMSEQS_EASYCLUSTER`\
  \ in the consuming pipeline's config if a\ndifferent cutoff is wanted.\n\nSupports\
  \ five callers via the per-record `caller` val: ribocode, ribotish,\nribotricer,\
  \ rpbp, price. Any subset can be supplied. When `ch_orf_tables` is empty\nthe subworkflow\
  \ short-circuits the merge + FASTA chain and the output\nchannels are empty.\n\n\
  Output meta is hardcoded to `[ id: 'cohort' ]`; downstream consumers that\nwant\
  \ a different cohort id should `.map` the emitted channels or\noverride `ext.prefix`\
  \ on `CUSTOM_ORFMERGE` / `BEDTOOLS_GETFASTA` /\n`SEQKIT_TRANSLATE` to control output\
  \ filenames.\n"
keywords:
- "orf"
- "ribo-seq"
- "catalogue"
- "merge"
- "translation"
components:
- "custom/orfnormalise"
- "custom/orfmerge"
- "bedtools/getfasta"
- "seqkit/translate"
- "mmseqs/easycluster"
- "custom/orfcollapse"
input:
- ch_orf_tables:
    description: "Per-sample, per-caller ORF prediction tables. All callers share\
      \ a\nsingle channel; the caller id is carried as a per-record `val`\n(one of:\
      \ ribocode, ribotish, ribotricer, rpbp, price) and selects\nthe parser inside\
      \ the normaliser.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(orf_table), val(caller) ]\n"
- ch_fasta:
    description: "Reference genome FASTA used by bedtools/getfasta to extract\ncatalogue\
      \ nucleotide sequences.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(fasta) ]\n"
- ch_gtf:
    description: "Reference annotation GTF. The ribocode and ribotish normalisers\
      \ use\nit to lift transcript coordinates to genomic blocks; rpbp and price\n\
      resolve gene ids from it, and rpbp has no fallback, so its ORFs get\nan empty\
      \ gene_id without it. Only ribotricer ignores it. Pass\n`[ [:], [] ]` only when\
      \ the caller subset is limited to ribotricer.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(gtf)\
      \ ]\n"
- val_collapse:
    description: "Cluster catalogue peptides by amino-acid identity (mmseqs/easycluster)\n\
      and fold each multi-member small-ORF cluster to one representative\n(custom/orfcollapse).\
      \ When false the merged catalogue is emitted\nunchanged and the clustering modules\
      \ do not run.\nStructure: val(collapse)\n"
output:
- catalogue_bed12:
    description: "Merged ORF catalogue as BED12.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bed12)\
      \ ]\n"
- catalogue_tsv:
    description: "Per-ORF table with `called_by_<caller>` / `score_<caller>` and\n\
      `n_samples` / `samples` provenance columns.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(tsv)\
      \ ]\n"
- orf_to_gene_tsv:
    description: "One row per (orf_id, gene_id, transcript_id) mapping; an ORF can\n\
      map to multiple host transcripts/genes.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(tsv) ]\n"
- catalogue_aa_fasta:
    description: "Catalogue amino-acid FASTA produced by seqkit translate from the\n\
      nucleotide extract of the merged BED12.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(faa) ]\n"
- multiqc:
    description: "MultiQC custom-content sidecar (per-class ORF counts).\nStructure:\
      \ [ val(meta), path(tsv) ]\n"
- consensus_bed12:
    description: "Consensus view of the catalogue as BED12 (ORFs meeting the\n--min-callers\
      \ / --min-samples thresholds; identical to the full\ncatalogue at the defaults\
      \ of 1/1). Taken from the amino-acid collapse\nwhen it runs, otherwise from\
      \ the merger.\nStructure: [ val(meta), path(bed12) ]\n"
- consensus_tsv:
    description: "Consensus-filtered per-ORF table, same columns as the full catalogue.\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(tsv) ]\n"
- consensus_orf_to_gene_tsv:
    description: "ORF-to-gene mapping restricted to the consensus-filtered ORFs.\n\
      Structure: [ val(meta), path(tsv) ]\n"
authors:
- "@pinin4fjords"
maintainers:
- "@pinin4fjords"
version: "0.0.0-6d1763b"
license: "MIT License"
kind: "Workflow"
requires:
  modules:
  - "nf-core/custom/orfnormalise@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/custom/orfmerge@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/bedtools/getfasta@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/seqkit/translate@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/mmseqs/easycluster@0.0.0-6d1763b"
  - "nf-core/custom/orfcollapse@0.0.0-6d1763b"
